Desc:     Add vLLM real-server cassette coverage. In-scope files: internal/provider/vllm tests and committed testdata/cassettes, plus any small server bootstrap helper used only by record-mode tests. Record mode must install or pull a CPU-capable vLLM runtime, start a trivial CPU model on a free local port with constrained concurrency such as --max-num-seqs 1 and small max model length, wait for /v1/models readiness, record /v1/models, /metrics, minimal /v1/chat/completions, and /metrics while at least one request is in flight or queued where feasible. Replay mode must be the default CI path and parse cassette data only. Out of scope: llama-server cassettes, route scoring, sticky leases, and hand-written HTTP mocks.
Accept:   1. go test ./internal/provider/vllm ./... -run 'VLLM.*Cassette|VLLM.*Utilization' passes in replay mode using committed cassettes. 2. FIZEAU_RECORD_PROVIDER_CASSETTES=1 go test ./internal/provider/vllm -run 'Record' installs or starts vLLM itself and refreshes cassettes without requiring a manually pre-started server. 3. Cassettes include real /v1/models, /metrics, minimal chat, and under-load metrics interactions. 4. Replay parsing extracts vllm:num_requests_running, vllm:num_requests_waiting, and kv_cache_usage_perc or legacy gpu_cache_usage_perc. 5. No hand-written endpoint mocks define the provider contract.

func doRecordRequest(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, method, url string, body io.Reader) {
	t.Helper()
	req, err := http.NewRequest(method, url, body)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer record-secret")
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, _ = io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	_ = resp.Body.Close()
}

func doReplayRequest(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, method, url string, body io.Reader, wantOK bool) (*http.Response, error) {
	t.Helper()
	req, err := http.NewRequest(method, url, body)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer replay-secret")
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if !wantOK {
		return resp, err
	}
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, resp)
	_, _ = io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	_ = resp.Body.Close()
	return resp, nil
}
